title: Week 9 AM report
body: Fix lineup: start Keenan Allen (WR) and Malik Washington (FLEX); bench DJ Moore and Hampton. Keep Evans (now Questionable) in; if he's DNP through Thu, start Strange Thursday. Optional: add Josh Downs, drop Sutton ($0-3).

title: Flash: Downs added, Moore back at FLEX
body: Downs added for Sutton ($0). Sleeper starts DJ Moore at FLEX again: bench Moore, start Malik Washington. Downs is first WR off the bench. Evans (Q): if DNP Wed+Thu, start Strange before Thu 8:15 ET.

title: Week 9 PM report
body: Sleeper still has DJ Moore at FLEX: bench him, start Malik Washington. Evans DNP Wed (ribs+Achilles, ~50%): if Out/Doubtful Fri start Downs; if inactive Sun swap in Hampton (4:05 ET). No waiver adds; hold $100.
